title: onboard-nadir-11b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Sophia Martinez
description: Onboard Nadir 11B v1.0: add metadata, performance profiles, and automate changelog generation. Context: Nadir-11b is an open LLM we validated for latency/cost tradeoffs on our latest runtime. This PR adds canonical metadata, curated performance profiles for common GPU classes, and wires the model onboarding step into our changelog automation so that new model releases produce standard release notes. Checklist: - [x] Add models/nadir/metadata.yaml with schema v2 fields (owner, tags, licenses, tokenizer hints) - [x] Add perf profiles for A100/RTX4090/T4 and CPU fallback - [x] Add lightweight perf benchmark CI job configuration - [x] Add generate_changelog.py template for model onboarding events - [x] Update model-registry schema version in registry_config.yaml - [x] Add unit tests for metadata validation and perf profile parsing Motivation: reduces manual steps when adding models, ensures consistent release notes and perf expectations in Console and model catalog. Testing: included unit tests under scripts/tests, local perf runs documented in PR and CI perf job executed against a small sample. Rollout plan: merge to main, staged canary onboarding to dedicated pool for 48 hours, publish release notes via the changelog pipeline. Related: ENG-3456 (model onboarding automation), PM-1187 (catalog UX for Nadir).

release_notes:
- Onboard nadir-11b v1.0: added metadata (owner, license, tokenizer_hint, max_context) and performance profiles for A100/RTX4090/T4.
- Automated changelog generation for model onboarding events so new models produce standard release notes in the Console.
- CI: added perf-smoke job to run lightweight latency checks for newly onboarded models.
notes_for_ops: Canary rollout to Dedicated pool for 48 hours post-merge. If p95 latency > 2x expected profile on A100, auto-revert via routing policy. Ops runbook updated under docs/onboarding/runbooks/nadir-onboard.md
acceptance_criteria: 1) metadata.yaml validates against schema v2; 2) perf profiles parsed and displayed in Console; 3) changelog pipeline emits an entry with model name, version, and perf summary; 4) CI perf-smoke must pass on main for at least one runner type
changelog_automation_details: Added scripts/changelog/generate_changelog.py and a changelog metadata block in models/nadir/metadata.yaml. The generator consumes onboarding events, templates a release note, and appends to RELEASE_NOTES.md. It supports Linear links and release channels (hosted, dedicated).
testing_summary: Unit tests for metadata validation added and passing. Perf-smoke CI executed with sample sequences; p50/p95 numbers recorded in PR and embedded in perf profiles. Manual verification: deployed model to dedicated canary pool and validated responses for a small prompt set.
notes_for_documentation: Updated model-catalog docs to surface tokenizer_hint and perf p50/p95 fields. Documentation PR will follow to add detailed benchmarking methodology for Nadir.
security_review: Not a data-sensitive change. License field set to Apache-2.0. No keys or secrets added. Security review: not required beyond standard repo scans.
notes: This PR consolidates onboarding steps into a repeatable pattern used by our model-registry team. Follow-up work: add auto-tagging for hardware compatibility and expand perf-job matrix to include dedicated T4 fleets.
